opening.argument: The walkthrough directs viewers through wallet-connected actions including MetaMask confirmation, liquidity provision, and contract deployment, while linking repeated activity to a speculative reward. It expressly says that “more transaction, more swap and provide more liquid” gives a “higher chance of getting the airdrop,” and instructs viewers to use “more than 10 transactions” and provide liquidity. The process also requires viewers to “simply connect your wallet” and confirm transactions, with guidance to increase a fee to 0.01 if a transaction stops. External links cover the network, faucet, bridge, swap, token, and contract-deployment steps. These are concrete instructions for acquiring a possible reward through low-barrier wallet and asset activity. The available evidence does not establish completed loss or official eligibility terms, but it does show the creator promoting these actions for a speculative airdrop outcome.
